Messages.Author: Brian
Messages.Body:
SO...

I put out Madness Network, Gilbert Duane, and Didi Meyers.

During my predator's turn, Gilbert Duane plays Chain of Command. I
choose Ozmo and Roland Bishop. I bleed with Roland unsuccessfully,
and then opt not to use the Madness Network for Ozmo. I opt to use
the Madness Network for Didi Meyers.

Is "all that can bleed have" now satisfied for Ozmo and Roland,
because I have waived the ability to act?

Or must they wait until my predator's influence phase, during which
they CANNOT bleed, even with Madness Network in play?

I assume they will not make it until my turn, and it pretty much
doesn't matter either way, but it's interesting to note.

-- Brian
